whatThisIs: Free English classes are offered to Massachusetts residents who are native speakers of languages such as Spanish, Haitian Creole, Arabic, Albanian, Somali, and more. ABCD aims to help parents support their children in school, find employment, and communicate more easily about medical care.
relatedLinkExplanation: Learn more about Action for Boston Community Development (ABCD).
whoItHelps: Non-native English speakers struggling to learn English on their own.
whatToKnow: You must be a Massachusetts resident to apply.
Classes are primarily held in Roxbury and Mattapan, but you do not need to live in these neighborhoods to apply.
You must be able to attend classes in Roxbury or Mattapan.
name: English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL)
